card.name: Digits in doses and quantities
card.fires_on: A single digit, often 1, 2, 4 or 5, placed in a dose, quantity or measurement. It is usually right before a fraction, decimal, unit or ordinal ending, such as 1½ tsp or 2.5 hours.

modes.label: Digit before a fraction
modes.description: The digit 1 or 2 starts a mixed number in a dosing table or recipe, right before ½ or ¼.

modes.label: Digit in a dose or time
modes.description: A digit starts a dose or time amount in dosing text, before a decimal or unit.
